title: 🔥 "IF YOU DIED TONIGHT, WOULD GOD LET YOU INTO HEAVEN?" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "IF YOU DIED TONIGHT, WOULD GOD LET YOU INTO HEAVEN?" 🚀🔥

📖 Matthew 7:22-23 – "Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and cast out demons in Your name, and do many mighty works in Your name?’ And then I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’"

🚨 What if you took your last breath tonight?
Would you wake up in the presence of Jesus? Or would you open your eyes in eternal separation from God?
Many people THINK they are going to heaven—but Jesus warned that many will be SHOCKED on Judgment Day! Let’s dive into the truth and see what the Bible really says.

🔥 1. MOST PEOPLE THINK THEY ARE GOING TO HEAVEN—BUT ARE THEY?
📖 Proverbs 16:25 – "There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to death."

✅ Many people believe they will go to heaven because they:
❌ Attend church occasionally.
❌ Try to be a "good person."
❌ Help the poor or do good deeds.
❌ Were baptized as a child.
❌ Believe in God but never truly surrendered to Christ.
🚨 None of these things can save you! Salvation is NOT about being a "good person"—it’s about being born again in Christ!
📖 John 3:3 – "Jesus answered him, ‘Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one is born again he cannot see the kingdom of God.’"
🔥 Are you truly born again, or just religious?

🔥 2. ETERNAL DESTINY IS SEALED AT DEATH—NO SECOND CHANCES!
📖 Hebrews 9:27 – "It is appointed for man to die once, and after that comes judgment."

✅ The moment you die, your eternity is sealed forever.
✅ There is no purgatory, no "waiting period," and no second chance to repent.
✅ You will either stand before God as His child or as His enemy.

📖 2 Thessalonians 1:8-9 – "In flaming fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and on those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus. They will suffer the punishment of eternal destruction, away from the presence of the Lord."
🚨 Hell is real, and many people are heading there thinking they are "good enough" for heaven!

🔥 3. HOW DO YOU KNOW IF YOU ARE TRULY SAVED?
📖 2 Corinthians 13:5 – "Examine yourselves, to see whether you are in the faith. Test yourselves. Or do you not realize this about yourselves, that Jesus Christ is in you—unless indeed you fail to meet the test?"

🔥 Ask yourself these questions:
✅ Have I truly repented of my sins, or do I still live in them? (Luke 13:3)
✅ Do I obey Jesus' commands, or do I just claim to follow Him? (John 14:15)
✅ Do I bear fruit in my life, or do I live like the world? (Matthew 7:16-17)
✅ Do I trust in Jesus ALONE, or do I rely on good works and religion? (Ephesians 2:8-9)
🚨 Many people claim to be "Christian," but their lives show otherwise. Are you truly saved?

🔥 4. JESUS IS THE ONLY WAY—NOT RELIGION, GOOD WORKS, OR CHURCH MEMBERSHIP!
📖 John 14:6 – "Jesus said to him, ‘I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’"
🔥 There is ONLY ONE WAY to heaven—JESUS!

❌ Not by being a "good person."
❌ Not by church attendance.
❌ Not by religious traditions or family background.
✅ ONLY by surrendering fully to Jesus Christ and being born again!
🚨 Have you truly given your life to Jesus, or are you just religious?

🔥 5. HOW TO BE 100% SURE YOU ARE GOING TO HEAVEN!
📖 Romans 10:9 – "If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved."

✅ Steps to True Salvation:
✔️ Admit you are a sinner (Romans 3:23).
✔️ Believe that Jesus Christ died and rose again for you (John 3:16).
✔️ Confess and repent of your sins (Acts 3:19).
✔️ Surrender your life fully to Jesus as Lord (Luke 9:23).
🚨 If you are not 100% sure of your salvation, TODAY is the time to surrender to Christ!

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: WHERE WILL YOU GO WHEN YOU DIE?
✅ Salvation is NOT about being a "good person"—it’s about being born again in Jesus Christ!
✅ The moment you die, your eternity is sealed—heaven or hell. No second chances.
✅ If you trust in anything other than Jesus ALONE, you are in danger of eternal separation from God!
🚨 DO NOT WAIT! REPENT AND FOLLOW JESUS NOW BEFORE IT’S TOO LATE!

✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you are 100% sure you are saved!
✅ 🚀 CLICK SHARE to wake up those who are deceived about salvation!
📢 🚨 WARNING: Many people think they are going to heaven, but they are deceived.

🙏 PRAYER FOR SALVATION
Heavenly Father, I come before You as a sinner in need of grace. I confess my sins and turn away from them. I believe that Jesus Christ died for me and rose again. Today, I surrender my life fully to You. Be my Lord, my Savior, and my King. Fill me with Your Holy Spirit and lead me in truth. Thank You for saving me! In Jesus’ name, AMEN! 🙏🔥
